items.q: how did Herbie get into your band? ... This was done for ABC, I think.

ctx.x: Also on this date it included Herbie Mann playing flute. I was just wondering – and this is the first time I‟ve seen his name in association with you on recordings. So I‟m just wondering, how did Herbie get into your band?
